anchors.label: Left chest (medals)
anchors.note: SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024): centred, the top of the medals 6 cm above the top edge of the left pocket flap (y = flap top 207.5 - 60 mm x pxPerMm), one row, in the order picked (no order of wear is given). Centred on the pocket: the PDF does not say what "centred" is measured from. pxPerMm is not calibrated. A row wider than 160 mm overlaps its medals so it fits: this comes from picture D-3 only (7 medals drawn about 1.2 x the flap width, flap = 131 mm); the PDF text gives no overlap rule. This drawing has no pocket flaps, so the spot is where number-1 puts it (the 6 cm and 1 cm distances are measured from where its flap would be). Same placement as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Left chest, above pocket
anchors.note: SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024): maximum 3 SAF badges in total, centred, bottom edge 1 cm above the left pocket flap (y = flap top 207.5 - 10 mm x pxPerMm), or 1 cm above the top of the medals when medals are worn. Exceptional skills badges come first. 1 or 2 badges are one row; 3 are a pyramid (first badge alone on top, the other two below). The PDF says the gap may change with 3 badges and medals but gives no number. pxPerMm is not calibrated. This drawing has no pocket flaps, so the spot is where number-1 puts it (the 6 cm and 1 cm distances are measured from where its flap would be). Same placement as number-1 (project owner). Badges are a fixed 39 mm (the art has transparent padding) and the two pyramid rows overlap by 16 px (rowGapPx -16), so 3 badges over medals still stay below the shoulder board: minY 75 is the lowest the top may reach (about y 70 is the board here), checked by a test. Sizes are chosen by eye, not from the regulations.

anchors.label: Right chest (foreign badges)
anchors.note: SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024): maximum 3, centred, bottom edge 1 cm above the top edge of the right pocket flap or in line with the SAF badges (if worn), whichever is higher. pxPerMm is not calibrated. This drawing has no pocket flaps, so the spot is where number-1 puts it (the 6 cm and 1 cm distances are measured from where its flap would be). Same placement as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Right side
anchors.note: Source says 'right side of the uniform'. Exact spot unknown. Same placement as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Left shoulder sleeve
anchors.note: Not more than two proficiency badges. SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024) p.15: centred on the shoulder board, base of the LOWER badge 15 cm down the sleeve from the shoulder seam; marksmanship below the IPPT badge (project owner). Position is a guess (scale not calibrated). The perspective sprites come from the badge-art-pipeline bundle and still use the older "first badge 15 cm down" spacing, so they need a re-export. Same placement as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Left sleeve (tabs)
anchors.note: Maximum of two tabs. SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024) p.15: centred on the shoulder board, 1 cm below the left shoulder seam, the second tab immediately before the first. Position is a guess (scale not calibrated). Same placement as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Right sleeve (foreign tabs)
anchors.note: Maximum of two tabs, worn the same way as on the left sleeve (SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024) p.15). Position is a guess (scale not calibrated). Same placement as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Right sleeve (foreign badges)
anchors.note: Maximum of two badges, worn the same way as on the left sleeve (SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024) p.15). Position is a guess (scale not calibrated). Same placement as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Shoulders
anchors.note: One board on each shoulder, button at the collar end. Drawn from number-1's perspective sprites (mountedFrom), because the shoulders and sleeves are in the same place; see docs/PERSPECTIVE.md in the badge-art-pipeline project.

anchors.label: Right sleeve (rank)
anchors.note: Lowest point of the chevron 24 cm from the shoulder seam, centre in line with the centre of the shoulder board (SAF No.1 Dress PDF, March 2024, p.8). Only the front half shows from the front. Position is a guess (scale not calibrated). Same placement as number-1 (project owner).
